The owed-work clause strengthened rather than weakened in the rewording, now naming D-086's G21 entry as the model and stating that the successor adds no new DR-G* row and settles neither NT-3 nor NT-5. A full diff against the frozen turn-1 bytes shows eight changed regions, all repairs, that improvement, or turn-2 bookkeeping, with Decision item 2, item 4, the readiness recital and the Reversibility clause untouched — I checked for a repair paid for by a deletion, which is the failure mode that sank the v4 gate-join draft, and there is none. Three items I considered and declined are recorded so the choices are auditable. What remains owed after this entry is the D-086 successor it creates and the leftover-design of NT-3 and NT-5; DR-133 stays OPEN, not eligible in kind, not SATISFIED, with its leftover-design open.
